item.title: Amazon Is Gutting Its AI Division After Sustained Failure

item.title: Article: Building an Offline-First AI Coding Tutor for Low-End Android Phones
item.description: This article is about engineering an offline-first app for low-end devices based on our experience in Nigeria and India. The interesting problems in this space are storage, quota, cold start, and failure-path design. (1 source: infoq)
